summary_en: This phase 1 study tests radiosurgery given before surgery for high grade glioma, a type of malignant glioma. Radiosurgery is one large dose given within 14 days of registration, followed by surgery, then standard radiation over 30 fractions and daily temozolomide, with or without tumor treating fields at the neuro-oncologist's discretion, starting within 4 to 6 weeks. The main outcome measure is not stated; the record describes the study as looking at possible benefits and side effects.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa la radiocirugía administrada antes de la cirugía para el glioma de alto grado, un tipo de glioma maligno. La radiocirugía consiste en una dosis única y grande, administrada dentro de los 14 días posteriores al registro, seguida de cirugía, luego radiación estándar en 30 fracciones y temozolomida diaria, con o sin terapia de campos tumorales según el criterio del neurooncólogo, iniciada en un plazo de 4 a 6 semanas. La medida de resultado principal no se indica; el registro describe el estudio como una evaluación de posibles beneficios y efectos secundarios.
who_for: Primary high grade glioma (WHO grade III-IV, including glioblastoma) judged by the Mayo neuro-oncology team.
Prior biopsy confirming high grade glioma is acceptable.
Planned neurosurgical resection of the tumor.
ECOG performance status 0, 1, or 2, and willing to receive adjuvant radiotherapy at the enrolling institution.
not_for: Pregnant women, or nursing women unwilling to stop nursing during therapy.
Use of systemic anti-cancer therapy within the previous 3 months.
Pathology showing grade I-II glioma, brain metastasis, or other brain tumor, or primary spinal cord or brainstem glioma.
